full_judgment: 11. The learned Advocate for the petitioner lastly submits that since the plaintiff got a sole decree in Partition Suit No.203 of 1998, the title of the plaintiff was established therein and in the present suit, he has also been successful to prove his exclusive possession in the suit property and, as such, the Court of Appeal below without considering the said judgment and decree passed in the said Partition Suit erroneously held that the title of the plaintiff could not be ascertained in such a suit while, he also failed to consider the plaintiff's exclusive possession in the suit property and thus, the impugned judgment and decree of the Court of Appeal below being not a proper judgment and decree of reversal, the same is liable to be set-aside and accordingly, the Rule should be made absolute.
